Neither release surface mentions shipping, so R05's answer (the figure was computed, understates itself by an unknown amount, and is deliberately withheld) reaches no reader of the release.

Both registered p-values are rendered as 0.0000 on both surfaces, which reads as p = 0. The true values are about 3e-157 for the completion test and smaller for the AOV test, so '< 0.0001' would be accurate.
The caveat 'one quarter of orders in this channel' can be read as 25% of the channel's orders rather than the orders of one calendar quarter.
